articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: BTBT), today announced that it has repaid $50 million of principal under its secured borrowing arrangement with Galaxy Digital. The repayment, funded through a partial sale of the Company’s ETH holdings, lowered outstanding Galaxy borrowings from $100.0 million to $50 million, a reduction of 50%.
articles.title: Bit Digital, Inc. Reduces Secured Borrowings from Galaxy Through Partial Sale of ETH Holdings
